text:
Asha Patel: Heads-up — thinking of tightening the weekly triage. Proposal: 30m box, split into two parallel lanes (Hotfix / Backlog), and add a rotating 'RFC quick-check' 5m slot every other week. Move from Wed 11am -> Thu 9am to catch US/EMEA overlap. Thoughts?

Tom Nguyen: sounds reasonable. Thu 9am works for me most weeks. Do we want mandatory pre-reads for RFCs? :thinking_face:

Asha Patel: Pre-reads yes: if you want the RFC slot, paste a 2-line TL;DR + link by EOD Wed. Otherwise we'll skip that mini-slot. Also want to reduce owner churn — propose owners commit for 2 weeks instead of 1.

Priya Shah: 2-week owners = yes from me. Means we can follow-up on lingering bugs. Thu 9am ok. One ask: can we keep a recurring "PR pre-read" thread in the agenda so reviewers can flag PRs?

Luis Gomez: Thu 9am is a little tight for my mornings, but still doable once every other week. Agree on pre-reads. For the two lanes, can we reserve first 10m for triage urgent items, then split? Something like:
```
- 0-10m urgent/high-pri triage (everyone)
- 10-30m split lanes: hotfix owner + backlog owner
- RFC quick-check 5m (every other week)
```

Asha Patel: I like that layout. I'll update the calendar invite & add 2-week owner cadence. Will also add a pinned weekly checklist in the channel: 'pre-reads, owner confirm, outstanding hotfixes'.

triage-bot: Reminder set: new recurrence Thu 09:00, 30m. RSVP opens 24h before.

Tom Nguyen: :thumbsup: One more — can we tag 'on-call' when urgent lane flips into incident? So owners don't miss it.

Asha Patel: yep — will add a line in the checklist to ping @eng-oncall for any item that looks like an incident. Thanks everyone — I'll ship the changes and post the updated agenda + invite link here shortly.
